concept.hr: Pohranjeni i reflektirani XSS; kodiranje izlaza
concept.en: Stored vs reflected XSS; output encoding

summary.hr: Objavi komentar sa skriptom i prati ga do preglednika drugog posjetitelja: bez kodiranja izlaza postaje čvor stranice i krade kolačić; kodiran ostaje tekst.
summary.en: Post a comment with a script and follow it into another visitor's browser: unencoded it becomes a page node and steals the cookie; encoded, it is text.
